title: Full injury report for Dean Wade, Sixers vs. Cavaliers in home opener
text:
Full injury report for Dean Wade, Sixers vs. Cavaliers in home opener Rumors Stats Odds Betting Newsletter SIXERS Full injury report for Dean Wade, Sixers vs. Cavaliers in home opener
 Ky Carlin Sixers Wire Oct. 21, 2026, 5:05 p.m. ET The Philadelphia 76ers will look to build off their season-opening win over the New York Knicks as they prepare for the home opener on Thursday against the Cleveland Cavaliers. It was an impressive performance for the Sixers to go into New York and spoil ring night for the Knicks.
 As the Sixers return home, they will look to continue growing as a team. As far as the injury report is concerned, of course, Ariel Hukporti (right ruptured Achilles) is out as he is out for the season. Tacko Fall (left quadriceps strain) and Dominick Barlow (low back stress reaction) are also out for this contest.
 Dean Wade (left ankle sprain) missed the opener with the Knicks after suffering the injury in the preseason finale against the Boston Celtics. He is listed as questionable against his former Cavaliers team.
 Tip off from the Xfinity Mobile Arena is set for 7 p.m. EDT on Thursday for the home debut of LeBron James and Jaylen Brown.
